Bottles In And Around The Trek Paths, Pamba And Sannidhanam-Suo Motu Proceedings

 ANNEXURES IN SSCR NO.17/2024  ANNEXURE 1: REPORT DATED 18/06/2024 SUBMITTED BY THE DEPUTY DIRECTOR, PERIYAR TIGER RESERVE WEST DIVISION.

2  Dated this the 27th day of June, 2024  ORDER Anil K. Narendran, J.
The description of the 4th respondent is suo motu corrected as "Deputy Director, Periyar Tiger Reserve (West Division), Peerumedu, Idukki-685531." 
2. The Special Commissioner, Sabarimala, has filed this report regarding the hazards caused to wildlife due to the dumping of glass soft drink bottles in and around the trekking path to Sabarimala and Sannidhanam by Sabarimala pilgrims. The 4th respondent Deputy Director, Periyar Tiger Reserve (West Division), has submitted a report dated 18.06.2024 before the Special Commissioner,
which forms part of this report as Annexure 1.
3. On 21.06.2024, when this matter came for consideration, the learned Senior Government Pleader and the respective Standing Counsel for the Travancore Devaswom Board and the Kerala State Pollution Control Board sought time to get instructions. By the order dated 21.02.2024, the learned Senior Government Pleader was directed to get instructions as to whether the sale of soft drinks in the Eco Shops by the Forest Department at Sabarimala is through soft drink dispenser machines. 
4. Today, when this matter is taken up for consideration the learned Senior Government Pleader would submit that an affidavit on behalf of the 4th respondent Deputy Director, shall be placed on record within a week. 
5. The learned Standing Counsel for the Kerala State Pollution Control Board has made available, for the perusal of this Court, Notification No.KPCB/50/2021-SEE-3 dated 28.11.2023 issued by the Pollution Control Board, wherein it is declared that the earlier orders issued by the Board are in force in the pilgrimage season of Sabarimala and the Travancore Devaswom Board, the Police Department, the Food and Safety Departments and the concerned Local Self Government Bodies shall ensure compliance of the aforesaid directions. 
6. In the aforesaid notification issued by the Pollution Control Board, reference has also been made to the order of this Court dated 11.06.2018 in SSCR No.7 of 2018, wherein it was noticed that the use of plastic pouches for bringing Kumkumam, Bhasmam, Manjalpodi, Karpooram, etc., in Irumudikettu and subsequently throwing of empty pouches at Sabarimala, connected with Sabarimala pilgrimage during the festival season had contributed to much plastic pollution in the area.
7. An affidavit on behalf of the 6th respondent, explaining the facts and circumstances, shall be placed on record within a week. 
List this matter on 11.07.2024.
